environment.description: AWS Lambda function with Function URL configured with AuthType=NONE. The function processes order events from SQS but also exposes a Function URL endpoint for manual reprocessing by operations team. No authentication is required on the Function URL - any internet caller can invoke it directly with arbitrary JSON payloads. The Lambda has network access to an RDS PostgreSQL instance in the same VPC. No input validation or parameterized queries are used.

config.vpc_config: Lambda in private subnet with RDS access
config.sqs_queue: Standard queue with no message validation
